en.title: [2027 Academic Year Major Transfer] Detailed Schedule for Departmental Interview (Practical) Exams
summary: The submission deadline for official English proficiency test scores is Monday, January 4, 2027, to your current department office.
The major transfer application period is from Wednesday, January 6, 2027, 10:00 to Thursday, January 7, 16:00 (strict deadline; no extensions).
Department interview (practical) exams will be held on Tuesday, January 12, 2027, only for departments requiring evaluation.
Please refer to the attachment for detailed schedules, locations, and formats (online or offline) by department.
Successful applicants are scheduled to be announced on the website on Tuesday, January 19, 2027, at 14:00.
en.easyExplanation: This notice provides the detailed schedule for the 2027 academic year major transfer application and departmental interviews/practical tests. Official English scores must be submitted to your current department office by January 4, 2027, and the online transfer application runs from January 6 at 10:00 to January 7 at 16:00. The interview and practical evaluations take place on January 12 for applicable departments, so applicants must check the attached file for exact times and locations.

<[2027학년도 전과전형] 학과별 면접(실기)고사 세부 일정 안내>
1. 2027학년도 전과전형 주요일정
가. 공인영어성적 제출 마감: 2027. 01. 04.(월)까지 / 현 소속학과 사무실 제출
나. 전과 신청: 2027. 01. 06.(수) 10:00 ~ 01. 07.(목) 16:00
다. 면접(실기)고사: 2027. 01. 12.(화)
라. 합격자 발표: 2027. 01. 19.(화) 14:00 예정 / 홈페이지 공지
※ 공인영어성적 제출 및 전과 신청 기간 엄수(시간 연장 절대 불가)
2. 면접(실기)고사 안내
가. 면접(실기)고사 평가 대상학과만 시행
나. 대상학과 전체 2027. 01. 12.(화) 하루 동안 진행(학과별 진행 시간은 상이)
다. 학과별 진행 시간, 장소 및 운영방식(온라인, 오프라인 방식)은 첨부파일 참고
라. 기타 문의사항은 첨부파일 지원 학과사무실로 문의
